notes: Gong for Slack notifications: call-recap cards (AI brief + highlights + next steps) and tracker/keyword alerts when a topic is mentioned on a customer call. Card = section with linked call title + attendees/duration fields + a highlights/quote section + context footer + a 'View call' URL button. Fits deal, account, and product/dev channels (feature requests surfacing from customer calls).

examples.name: call_recap
examples.when: A customer call has been recorded and Gong's AI recap is ready.

• Schedule pilot kickoff
